notes: Section 56.05 defines every term used in §56.10's disclosure restrictions. Without §56.05, the scope of §56.10 cannot be determined — who is a provider, what is medical information, who is a patient.
Section 56.05's definition of 'medical information' determines what information is subject to §56.11's further-disclosure prohibition.
Section 56.05 defines what constitutes 'confidential information' whose release triggers §56.35 damages.

CMIA §56.05(f) 'medical information' is broader than HIPAA's 'protected health information' — CMIA includes pharmaceutical companies and contractors not covered by HIPAA's covered entity definition. CMIA §56.05(b) explicitly references HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522(b) for confidential communications requests.
Section 56.05's definition of 'patient' and 'provider of health care' determines who has access rights under §56.20.
